title: pilosella ziziana subsp. leptophylla
intro: Pilosella ziziana subsp. leptophylla, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a perennial herb native to Europe. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and gastrointestinal issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella ziziana subsp. leptophylla include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
